template.title: Onshore wind farm 33 MW
template.description: Ten wind turbines on a 30 kV collector with a 110 kV grid connection, a shunt reactor and a park controller for reactive power. Good for load flow, short circuit and grid-code P-Q / U-Q checks.

template.title: Offshore wind farm with 100 km export cable
template.description: 30 × 15 MW turbines, an offshore substation and a 100 km 275 kV export cable to a 400 kV grid substation, with an SSC (STATCOM), park controller and plant supervisory controller. Built for grid-code P-Q / U-Q and line-current studies.

template.title: PV solar farm 100 MW
template.description: Seven PV systems with 0.8 kV inverters on a 20 kV collector, a 110 kV grid connection and a shunt reactor.

template.title: Hybrid PV + BESS plant 30 MW
template.description: 30 MWp PV and an 8 MW / 10 MWh battery on a 33 kV collector behind a 50 MVA 110/33 kV OLTC transformer and a 12 km overhead line. Scenario: full PV output while the battery charges.

template.title: Small hydro plant 2 × 4.5 MVA
template.description: Two salient-pole generators on a 6.3 kV busbar, a 10 MVA step-up transformer and a 9 km 20 kV line to the utility, with station service. Shows the generator short-circuit contribution (IEC 60909, K_G correction).

template.title: Islanded microgrid (diesel + PV + BESS)
template.description: No utility connection: two diesel gensets (the larger one is the slack), an 11 kV village network, a water plant with a 200 kW pump and a PV + battery site. Shows the low fault levels of island grids.

template.title: Substation 220/110/20 kV (3-winding)
template.description: 220 kV grid and a 160/160/50 MVA three-winding transformer; the 20 kV tertiary carries a capacitor bank and station service, the 110 kV side feeds a meshed network with two towns and a wind farm. Try load flow, short circuit and N-1 contingency.

template.title: IEEE 4 bus
template.description: 4-bus, 230 kV textbook case from Grainger & Stevenson. The smallest network to learn load flow on.

template.title: IEEE 5 bus
template.description: 5-bus PJM test case at 230 kV with five generating units.

template.title: IEEE 6 bus
template.description: 6-bus, 3-generator case from Wood & Wollenberg, Power Generation, Operation and Control.

template.title: IEEE 9 bus
template.description: Classic 9-bus, 3-machine system (WSCC, Anderson & Fouad) at 345 kV. A good first network for load flow, OPF and contingency analysis.

template.title: IEEE 14 bus
template.description: IEEE 14-bus system with five generating units, transformers and a shunt capacitor. The most widely used small test grid.

template.title: IEEE RTS 24 bus
template.description: IEEE Reliability Test System (RTS-24): 24 buses at 230/138 kV with many generating units.

template.title: IEEE 30 bus
template.description: IEEE 30-bus system in the MATPOWER version (single 135 kV base) with six generating units.

template.title: IEEE 30 bus (Illinois)
template.description: IEEE 30-bus system with its real voltage levels (132/33/11 kV), as published by the Illinois Center for a Smarter Electric Grid.

template.title: IEEE 39 bus (New England)
template.description: IEEE 39-bus New England system with ten generators at 345 kV. A standard case for stability and contingency studies.

template.title: IEEE 57 bus
template.description: IEEE 57-bus system, a part of the American Electric Power grid in the early 1960s.

template.title: PEGASE 89 bus
template.description: 89-bus extract of the European high-voltage grid (380/220/150 kV) from the PEGASE project.

template.title: IEEE 118 bus
template.description: IEEE 118-bus system, a part of the American Electric Power grid in the US Midwest, with 54 generating units.

template.title: IEEE 145 bus (50 generators)
template.description: IEEE 145-bus, 50-generator dynamic test case.

template.title: Illinois 200 bus
template.description: Synthetic 200-bus grid on the footprint of central Illinois (Texas A&M synthetic grids).

template.title: IEEE 300 bus
template.description: IEEE 300-bus test system, the largest of the classic IEEE cases.

template.title: Italian grid, 10-bus equivalent
template.description: Equivalent 10-bus model of the Italian 380 kV transmission grid, one bus per market zone or region.

template.title: GB reduced network
template.description: Reduced 29-bus model of the Great Britain transmission system (400/275/132 kV).

template.title: Iceland
template.description: Model of the Icelandic power system with 189 buses.

template.title: PEGASE 1354 bus
template.description: 1354-bus part of the European high-voltage transmission grid from the PEGASE project.

template.title: RTE 1888 bus
template.description: Snapshot of the French transmission grid from RTE with 1888 buses.

template.title: GB network
template.description: Full Great Britain transmission network model with 2224 buses.

template.title: RTE 2848 bus
template.description: Snapshot of the French transmission grid from RTE with 2848 buses.

template.title: PEGASE 2869 bus
template.description: 2869-bus model of the European high-voltage grid from the PEGASE project.

template.title: Polish 3120 bus
template.description: Polish 400/220/110 kV grid at the summer 2008 morning peak (3120 buses).

template.title: Primary substation 110/20 kV with feeders
template.description: Two 40 MVA 110/20 kV transformers and a split 20 kV busbar: urban cable feeders in an open ring, an industrial customer and a rural overhead feeder with a 5 MW PV park.

template.title: Multi-voltage example
template.description: pandapower multi-voltage example from 380 kV down to 0.4 kV, with a three-winding transformer, extended wards, an impedance and many static generators.

template.title: MV Oberrhein (load case)
template.description: Real 20 kV network in the German Oberrhein region: 179 buses fed from two 110/20 kV substations. Case with high load and low generation.

template.title: MV Oberrhein (generation case)
template.description: Real 20 kV network in the German Oberrhein region: 179 buses fed from two 110/20 kV substations. Case with low load and high distributed generation.

template.title: Industrial plant 6 kV with motors
template.description: 110 kV supply and a 16 MVA transformer to a 6 kV switchboard with a 2.5 MW compressor, pumps, a fan, power-factor correction and two LV unit substations. Try short circuit with motor contribution and motor starting.

template.title: Commercial building LV distribution
template.description: 20 kV supply and two 1 MVA transformers feeding switchboards A and B, with floor boards, a kitchen, a data room, EV parking and 150 kWp rooftop PV. For voltage drop and TN-system fault currents.

template.title: EV fast-charging hub
template.description: 2.2 MW hub: eight 150 kW DC chargers, two 350 kW high-power chargers, a 400 kW / 1 MWh buffer battery and 100 kWp canopy PV behind two 20/0.4 kV transformers.

template.title: CIGRE HV
template.description: CIGRE high-voltage benchmark: 13 buses at 380/220 kV with three generators.

template.title: CIGRE MV
template.description: CIGRE European medium-voltage benchmark: two 20 kV feeders from a 110/20 kV substation, with switches to close rings.

template.title: CIGRE MV with PV and wind
template.description: CIGRE European medium-voltage benchmark with PV and wind generation along the feeders.

template.title: CIGRE MV with all DER
template.description: CIGRE European medium-voltage benchmark with all distributed resources: PV, wind, fuel cells, CHP and batteries.

template.title: CIGRE LV
template.description: CIGRE European low-voltage benchmark: residential, industrial and commercial 0.4 kV feeders from a 20 kV supply.

template.title: Synthetic LV rural
template.description: Synthetic rural low-voltage grid with PV, made for voltage-control studies (pandapower).

template.title: Synthetic LV village
template.description: Synthetic village low-voltage grid with PV, made for voltage-control studies (pandapower).

template.title: Dickert LV: long cable, good
template.description: Dickert benchmark LV grid: long cable feeders, several customers per connection, good case (strong lines).

template.title: Dickert LV: long cable + overhead, average
template.description: Dickert benchmark LV grid: long mixed cable and overhead-line feeders, several customers per connection, average case.

template.title: Kerber village grid (Dorfnetz)
template.description: Kerber village network: a typical German rural low-voltage grid behind a 10/0.4 kV transformer.

template.title: Dickert LV: long cable, bad
template.description: Dickert benchmark LV grid: long cable feeders, several customers per connection, bad case (weak lines).

template.title: Synthetic LV suburb
template.description: Synthetic suburban low-voltage grid with PV, made for voltage-control studies (pandapower).

template.title: Dickert LV: long cable, average
template.description: Dickert benchmark LV grid: long cable feeders, several customers per connection, average case.

template.title: IEEE European LV test feeder
template.description: IEEE European Low Voltage Test Feeder: 907 buses and 55 single-phase loads behind an 11/0.416 kV transformer. For unbalanced studies.

template.title: Optimal Power Flow
template.description: Tutorial: two generators with cost functions and an external grid supply loads over a 220/110 kV network (pandapower OPF basic example).

template.title: Contingency analysis
template.description: Tutorial: N-1 contingency analysis of the IEEE 9-bus case (pandapower contingency example).

template.title: Time Series Simulation
template.description: Tutorial: a 5-bus 110/20 kV network with one load and one static generator driven by time profiles (pandapower time-series example).

template.title: BESS Overvoltage in Weak Grids
template.description: Tutorial: a battery on a 110/33 kV connection, with scenarios that change grid strength and inverter control to show when exporting causes overvoltage.

template.title: Arc Flash Analysis (IEEE 1584)
template.description: Tutorial: arc flash incident energy (IEEE 1584) on a 20/0.4 kV network with LV switchboards.

template.title: Data center interconnection (utility pocket)
template.description: Guide page: import the data center utility-pocket model from Python, then run load flow, site screening, ANSI short circuit and transient stability.

template.title: IEEE 118-bus transmission benchmark
template.description: Guide page: import the IEEE 118-bus benchmark from a Python script and lay it out automatically.

template.title: IEEE 300-bus transmission benchmark
template.description: Guide page: import the IEEE 300-bus benchmark from a Python script and lay it out automatically.

template.title: Comparing with PowerFactory
template.description: Eight pages that compare Electrisim with DIgSILENT PowerFactory: load-flow test cases and three-, two- and single-phase short circuits.
